queriesList.name: Active Pipelines

options.description: Pipelines currently mapped to at least one dataflow. Current state; ignores the time range.
options.label: Pipelines

queriesList.query: count(group by (pipelineName)(apica_ingest_pipeline_status{pipelineName=~'.*', exported_namespace=~'.*', app=~'.*', service='logiq-flash'} > 0)) or vector(0)

queriesList.name: Active Rules

options.description: Rules attached to pipelines that run on at least one dataflow. Current state; ignores the time range.
options.label: Rules

queriesList.query: count(group by (pipelineName, ruleName)(apica_pipeline_rules_namespace_app_mapping{pipelineName=~'.*', exported_namespace=~'.*', app=~'.*', service='logiq-flash'} > 0)) or vector(0)

queriesList.name: Active Data Flows

options.description: Namespace/app dataflows with at least one pipeline mapped. Current state; ignores the time range.
options.label: Data Flows

queriesList.query: count(group by (exported_namespace, app)(apica_ingest_pipeline_status{pipelineName=~'.*', exported_namespace=~'.*', app=~'.*', service='logiq-flash'} > 0)) or vector(0)

queriesList.name: Active Forwarders

options.description: Forward targets mapped to at least one dataflow. Current state; ignores the time range.
options.label: Forwarders

queriesList.query: count(group by (target)(flow_forwarder_mapping{exported_namespace=~'.*', app=~'.*', service='logiq-flash'} > 0)) or vector(0)

queriesList.name: Bytes Filtered

options.description: Bytes in minus bytes out across the selected pipelines, in the selected time range.
options.label: Bytes Filtered

queriesList.query: round(sum(increase(apica_ingest_pipeline_bytes_in{pipelineName=~'.*', exported_namespace=~'.*', app=~'.*', service='logiq-flash'}[{{__range}}])) - sum(increase(apica_ingest_pipeline_bytes_out{pipelineName=~'.*', exported_namespace=~'.*', app=~'.*', service='logiq-flash'}[{{__range}}])), 0.01) or vector(0)&duration=1h

queriesList.name: Bytes Difference (Saved) %

options.description: Share of ingested bytes that pipelines did not pass on: 1 - bytes out / bytes in, over the selected time range.

queriesList.query: round((1 - sum(increase(apica_ingest_pipeline_bytes_out{pipelineName=~'.*', exported_namespace=~'.*', app=~'.*', service='logiq-flash'}[{{__range}}])) / (sum(increase(apica_ingest_pipeline_bytes_in{pipelineName=~'.*', exported_namespace=~'.*', app=~'.*', service='logiq-flash'}[{{__range}}])) > 0)) * 100, 0.01) or vector(0)&duration=1h

queriesList.name: Events Difference (Saved)

options.description: Events in minus events out across the selected pipelines, in the selected time range.
options.label: Events Saved

queriesList.query: round(sum(increase(apica_pipeline_events_in{pipelineName=~'.*', exported_namespace=~'.*', app=~'.*', service='logiq-flash'}[{{__range}}])) - sum(increase(apica_pipeline_events_out{pipelineName=~'.*', exported_namespace=~'.*', app=~'.*', service='logiq-flash'}[{{__range}}])), 0.01) or vector(0)&duration=1h

queriesList.name: Events Filtered In vs Out %

options.description: Share of events that pipelines did not pass on: 1 - events out / events in, over the selected time range.

queriesList.query: round((1 - sum(increase(apica_pipeline_events_out{pipelineName=~'.*', exported_namespace=~'.*', app=~'.*', service='logiq-flash'}[{{__range}}])) / (sum(increase(apica_pipeline_events_in{pipelineName=~'.*', exported_namespace=~'.*', app=~'.*', service='logiq-flash'}[{{__range}}])) > 0)) * 100, 0.01) or vector(0)&duration=1h

options.description: Bytes that entered pipelines in the selected time range.
options.label: Bytes In

options.description: Average bytes per second that entered pipelines over the selected time range.
options.label: per second

options.description: Events that entered pipelines in the selected time range.
options.label: Events In

options.description: Average events per second that entered pipelines over the selected time range.
options.label: per second

options.description: Bytes that left pipelines in the selected time range.
options.label: Bytes Out

options.description: Average bytes per second that left pipelines over the selected time range.
options.label: per second

options.description: Events that left pipelines in the selected time range.
options.label: Events Out

options.description: Average events per second that left pipelines over the selected time range.
options.label: per second

queriesList.name: Total Bytes Reduction In vs Out %

options.description: 1 - bytes out / bytes in across all selected pipelines, per time step.

queriesList.query: round((1 - sum(rate(apica_ingest_pipeline_bytes_out{pipelineName=~'.*', exported_namespace=~'.*', app=~'.*', service='logiq-flash'}[{{__interval}}])) / (sum(rate(apica_ingest_pipeline_bytes_in{pipelineName=~'.*', exported_namespace=~'.*', app=~'.*', service='logiq-flash'}[{{__interval}}])) > 0)) * 100, 0.01)&duration=1h&step=5m

queriesList.name: Total Events Reduction In vs Out %

options.description: 1 - events out / events in across all selected pipelines, per time step.

queriesList.query: round((1 - sum(rate(apica_pipeline_events_out{pipelineName=~'.*', exported_namespace=~'.*', app=~'.*', service='logiq-flash'}[{{__interval}}])) / (sum(rate(apica_pipeline_events_in{pipelineName=~'.*', exported_namespace=~'.*', app=~'.*', service='logiq-flash'}[{{__interval}}])) > 0)) * 100, 0.01)&duration=1h&step=5m

queriesList.name: Bytes Saved per Pipeline %

options.description: 1 - bytes out / bytes in per pipeline. 50 means the pipeline passes on half of what it receives.

queriesList.query: round((1 - sum by (pipelineName)(rate(apica_ingest_pipeline_bytes_out{pipelineName=~'.*', exported_namespace=~'.*', app=~'.*', service='logiq-flash'}[{{__interval}}])) / (sum by (pipelineName)(rate(apica_ingest_pipeline_bytes_in{pipelineName=~'.*', exported_namespace=~'.*', app=~'.*', service='logiq-flash'}[{{__interval}}])) > 0)) * 100, 0.01)&duration=1h&step=5m

queriesList.name: Events Saved per Pipeline %

options.description: 1 - events out / events in per pipeline.

queriesList.query: round((1 - sum by (pipelineName)(rate(apica_pipeline_events_out{pipelineName=~'.*', exported_namespace=~'.*', app=~'.*', service='logiq-flash'}[{{__interval}}])) / (sum by (pipelineName)(rate(apica_pipeline_events_in{pipelineName=~'.*', exported_namespace=~'.*', app=~'.*', service='logiq-flash'}[{{__interval}}])) > 0)) * 100, 0.01)&duration=1h&step=5m

queriesList.name: Bytes Saved per Pipeline

options.description: Bytes in minus bytes out per pipeline, per time step.

queriesList.query: round(sum by (pipelineName)(increase(apica_ingest_pipeline_bytes_in{pipelineName=~'.*', exported_namespace=~'.*', app=~'.*', service='logiq-flash'}[{{__interval}}])) - sum by (pipelineName)(increase(apica_ingest_pipeline_bytes_out{pipelineName=~'.*', exported_namespace=~'.*', app=~'.*', service='logiq-flash'}[{{__interval}}])), 0.01)&duration=1h&step=5m

queriesList.name: Events Saved per Pipeline

options.description: Events in minus events out per pipeline, per time step.

queriesList.query: round(sum by (pipelineName)(increase(apica_pipeline_events_in{pipelineName=~'.*', exported_namespace=~'.*', app=~'.*', service='logiq-flash'}[{{__interval}}])) - sum by (pipelineName)(increase(apica_pipeline_events_out{pipelineName=~'.*', exported_namespace=~'.*', app=~'.*', service='logiq-flash'}[{{__interval}}])), 0.01)&duration=1h&step=5m

queriesList.name: Total Bytes In vs Out (per second)

options.description: Bytes per second entering and leaving all selected pipelines.

queriesList.query: label_replace(round(sum(rate(apica_ingest_pipeline_bytes_in{pipelineName=~'.*', exported_namespace=~'.*', app=~'.*', service='logiq-flash'}[{{__interval}}])), 0.01), 'direction', 'in', '', '') or label_replace(round(sum(rate(apica_ingest_pipeline_bytes_out{pipelineName=~'.*', exported_namespace=~'.*', app=~'.*', service='logiq-flash'}[{{__interval}}])), 0.01), 'direction', 'out', '', '')&duration=1h&step=5m

queriesList.name: Total Events In vs Out (per second)

options.description: Events per second entering and leaving all selected pipelines.

queriesList.query: label_replace(round(sum(rate(apica_pipeline_events_in{pipelineName=~'.*', exported_namespace=~'.*', app=~'.*', service='logiq-flash'}[{{__interval}}])), 0.01), 'direction', 'in', '', '') or label_replace(round(sum(rate(apica_pipeline_events_out{pipelineName=~'.*', exported_namespace=~'.*', app=~'.*', service='logiq-flash'}[{{__interval}}])), 0.01), 'direction', 'out', '', '')&duration=1h&step=5m

options.description: 95th percentile time one rule takes on one event, per pipeline, in milliseconds.

queriesList.name: Top Bytes Reducing Pipelines (%)

options.description: The 20 pipelines with the highest bytes reduction (1 - bytes out / bytes in) in the selected time range.

queriesList.query: topk(20, round((1 - sum by (pipelineName)(increase(apica_ingest_pipeline_bytes_out{pipelineName=~'.*', exported_namespace=~'.*', app=~'.*', service='logiq-flash'}[{{__range}}])) / (sum by (pipelineName)(increase(apica_ingest_pipeline_bytes_in{pipelineName=~'.*', exported_namespace=~'.*', app=~'.*', service='logiq-flash'}[{{__range}}])) > 0)) * 100, 0.01))&duration=1h

queriesList.name: Bytes In vs Out by Pipeline (per second)

options.description: Bytes per second entering and leaving each pipeline.

queriesList.query: label_replace(sum by (pipelineName)(rate(apica_ingest_pipeline_bytes_in{pipelineName=~'.*', exported_namespace=~'.*', app=~'.*', service='logiq-flash'}[{{__interval}}])), 'direction', 'in', '', '') or label_replace(sum by (pipelineName)(rate(apica_ingest_pipeline_bytes_out{pipelineName=~'.*', exported_namespace=~'.*', app=~'.*', service='logiq-flash'}[{{__interval}}])), 'direction', 'out', '', '')&duration=1h&step=5m

queriesList.name: Events In vs Out by Pipeline (per second)

options.description: Events per second entering and leaving each pipeline.

queriesList.query: label_replace(sum by (pipelineName)(rate(apica_pipeline_events_in{pipelineName=~'.*', exported_namespace=~'.*', app=~'.*', service='logiq-flash'}[{{__interval}}])), 'direction', 'in', '', '') or label_replace(sum by (pipelineName)(rate(apica_pipeline_events_out{pipelineName=~'.*', exported_namespace=~'.*', app=~'.*', service='logiq-flash'}[{{__interval}}])), 'direction', 'out', '', '')&duration=1h&step=5m

queriesList.name: Volume Reduction by Dataflow

options.description: 1 - bytes out / bytes in per pipeline, namespace and app.

queriesList.query: (1 - sum by (pipelineName, exported_namespace, app)(rate(apica_ingest_pipeline_bytes_out{pipelineName=~'.*', exported_namespace=~'.*', app=~'.*', service='logiq-flash'}[{{__interval}}])) / (sum by (pipelineName, exported_namespace, app)(rate(apica_ingest_pipeline_bytes_in{pipelineName=~'.*', exported_namespace=~'.*', app=~'.*', service='logiq-flash'}[{{__interval}}])) > 0)) * 100&duration=1h&step=5m

options.description: Events per second dropped by rules, per pipeline.

queriesList.name: Pipeline to Dataflow Mapping

options.description: Namespace and app each pipeline runs on, with its execution order. Current state.

queriesList.query: max by (pipelineName, exported_namespace, app, execution_order)(apica_ingest_pipeline_status{pipelineName=~'.*', exported_namespace=~'.*', app=~'.*', service='logiq-flash'} > 0)
